name: humainity
description: Privacy-preserving, health-aware healthcare workforce management platform

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:reset && npm run setup:solver
scripts.build: npm -w @humainity/api run build && npm -w @humainity/web run build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
